Field Notes

From vacant lots to growing community

In 2021, a five-person steering committee in Boston's Roslindale neighborhood set out to convert four neglected lots into community gardens. By 2023, they had raised $85,000, built three nonprofit partnerships, and connected 120 families to growing plots — without a paid staff member.

Their toolkit: the same outreach checklist, meeting agenda, and grant readiness framework you'll find in this library. Read how they put it all together.
